answer_1.quote: Post Connection Generation (PC-G): Given the post context, the meme, and a set of relevant comments, models are required to generate a free-form text. This text should explain the key logical or thematic connections linking these elements. Post Intent Generation (PI-G): Based on all available evidence (post context, meme, and comments), models must generate the original poster's communicative intent.
answer_1.outputs: Free-form text explanations of post connections and communicative intents

answer_2.quote: For generative tasks, we use BERTScore (B-S) and ROUGE-L (R-L) to evaluate semantic and lexical similarity.
